function listPosts({url,$}) {const posts=[];$('item,entry').each((i,e)=>{const n=$(e);posts.push({url:n.find('link').attr('href')||n.find('link').text().trim(),title:n.find('title').text().trim(),publishedAt:n.find('pubDate,published,updated').first().text().trim()});});return {posts,next:null};}
function parsePost({url,$}) {const title=$("h1").first().text().trim();const body=$("main article").first().clone();body.find('script,style,nav,aside,footer,.toc,.table-of-contents,.post-tags,.post-meta,.blog-post-title,.title,.upvote-button,.embedded.blog-posts').remove();return {title,bodyHtml:body.html()||'',author:$('meta[name="author"]').attr('content')||null,publishedAt:$('meta[property="article:published_time"]').attr('content')||$('time[datetime]').first().attr('datetime')||$('meta[name="date"]').attr('content')||null,tags:$('a[rel="tag"]').map((i,e)=>$(e).text().trim()).get()};}
